text_en: The Croma you've met base all of their technology on vimana crystals.
The electromagnetism they emit is in perfect harmony with their own bodies, allowing them to create all kinds of contraptions and gadgets that we could barely even imagine.
They seem to be a highly advanced civilisation. I think I understand why they're not seen so much in Hafin. This city isn't bad, but its advances aren't so different to our own.
